The wheels are standard bicycle size (26-28 inches). The overall silhouette is a stretched bicycle profile with two distinct rider positions.

objects.taxonomy_description: Asian proboscidean measuring 250-300 cm at shoulder weighing 3000-5000 kg. Body massive with thick wrinkled gray-brown skin and sparse body hair. Head broad with twin-domed skull. Ears relatively small compared to African elephant. Trunk (proboscis) elongated and muscular with single finger-like projection at tip. Tusks present primarily in males, shorter than African species. Body barrel-shaped with arched back. Legs pillar-like with five toenails on forefeet. Tail long with terminal tuft. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart.

objects.taxonomy_description: Stocky tailless marsupial measuring 60-85 cm in body length with robust rounded body form. Fur is dense, woolly, and grey-brown with distinctive white patches on chest, ears, and rump. Ears are large, rounded, and prominently furry with white marginal tufts. Nose is broad, leathery, and black with distinctive textured surface. Limbs are powerful with five digits each; forefeet feature two opposable thumbs for gripping eucalyptus branches. Claws are sharp and curved for climbing. Body exhibits stocky proportions with broad chest and rounded abdomen. Head is broad with small eyes and inconspicuous ears relative to body size. Weight ranges 4-15 kg with sexual dimorphism. Posture is typically upright when seated on branches.
